author: OhLookItsDaOne
short: Forward messages via command or context menu
description: Lets users with an allowed role forward a message to a configured target channel via the `forward` command or the message context menu. The forwarded message mentions the author, links back to the original and includes attachments.
install_msg: Cog installed. Configure it with `[p]forward settarget` and `[p]forward addrole`.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores only guild configuration (target channel ID and allowed role IDs). No end user data is stored.
